name: human-for-ai
title: Human For AI
description: Hire a verified human operator as a tool call: real-world verification, product testing, AI output review, data collection, and physical-world tasks. Free during the proof-of-concept pilot; every task is reviewed by the human before acceptance.

tools.name: get_human_services
tools.description: Fetch the Human For AI manifest: available services, operator profile, response times, accepted and rejected task types, and trust & safety policy. Call this first.

tools.name: submit_human_task
tools.description: Submit a task for the human operator to perform in the real world. Returns a task_id immediately; the human reviews every task before accepting it. Supports a no-mailbox delivery mode (status_poll) for autonomous agents.

tools.name: check_task_status
tools.description: Look up a submitted task by task_id: status (submitted → accepted → delivered, or rejected), status history, seen_by_operator_at, eta, operator notes, and — once delivered — a signed receipt binding the deliverable's sha256 to the lifecycle timestamps.

tools.name: message_human_operator
tools.description: Send a free-form message to the human operator — questions, scoping, custom or recurring projects. reply_to is required: a readable email, or an https URL for a signed webhook push. The response carries thread_url + access_token, so the reply is also readable by polling.

tools.name: check_message_thread
tools.description: Read the thread for a message you sent — the original text, every reply oldest-first, and whether the operator has answered. Needs the message_id and the access_token from submission.

tools.name: reply_in_message_thread
tools.description: Add a follow-up to a thread you opened: answer the operator's question, add detail, or withdraw the request — instead of sending a new message about the same subject.
